moodys.citation_text: No Moody's rating found in trade press for UofL Health; system appears to be rated only by S&P and Fitch.

sp.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings downgraded UofL Health's Series 2022A bonds to BBB-plus from A-minus in September [2024], with a negative outlook — implying A- entering 2023.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch downgraded UofL Health's IDR and Series 2022A/B bonds to BBB from BBB-plus — implying BBB+ entering 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch downgraded UofL Health from BBB+ to BBB; stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Weaker than expected financial performance in fiscal year 2024 and anticipated slow recovery over coming fiscal years; persistent expense pressures, payor denials, and delayed reimbursements
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch Ratings downgraded UofL Health's issuer default rating and Series 2022A & 2022B revenue bonds to BBB from BBB-plus. 'Persistent expense pressures, payor denials, and delayed reimbursements continue to challenge UofL's operations and financial stability,' according to Fitch.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P downgraded UofL Health from A- to BBB+; negative outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Sizable operating losses, low days cash on hand, and reduced ratio of unrestricted reserves to long-term debt
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P Global Ratings downgraded UofL Health's Series 2022A bonds to BBB-plus from A-minus in September and gave a negative outlook to the new rating.

sp.citation_text: S&P BBB+ negative outlook after September 2024 downgrade.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch BBB stable after August 2024 downgrade.

outcome_class_rationale: Both Fitch and S&P downgraded UofL Health by one notch each in 2024 (Fitch BBB+ → BBB August 2024; S&P A- → BBB+ September 2024). Per schema, DOWNGRADE = exactly one notch down by one or two agencies. Not MULTI_DOWNGRADE because no two-notch action and only two agencies rate the credit (Moody's not on it). Note: pilot text mentioned 'August 2024' for the downgrade; sources confirm August/September 2024 timing.
